_about: Suggestions for review. Nothing on this page is implemented until the owner picks an option. Reply with 'SUG-NN: <letter>' or edit this file on a branch. 'Recommended' is a default, not a decision.

suggestions.suggestion: Confirm that the submitted links carry the Associates tag before any further content is published.

options.A: Keep the submitted short links; owner tests each in Associates Central (steps: sign in, click, check the tracking report).
options.B: Replace with https://www.amazon.com/dp/ASIN?tag=shopnow047c-20 links, using ASINs from products.json.
options.C: Generate Special Links per ASIN in Associates Central and paste them into products.json.

suggestions.recommended: A, then C. Keeps the links the owner submitted until the owner's test passes (SRC-02 2(b)).

options.A: Run analytics/collect_server.py on a server or container you control, with a domain and HTTPS.
options.B: Use a privacy-focused hosted analytics product (requires an account, which needs your input).
options.C: Leave measurement off until a decision is made.

suggestions.recommended: A. The receiver stores daily counts only and keeps no IPs or user agents.
